key_point: The bad review that created a horror icon
title: The bad review that created a horror icon
caption: Five Nights at Freddy's exists because reviewers said Scott Cawthon's family game looked like creepy animatronics. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #fnaf #fivenightsatfreddys

instagram.caption:
Before Five Nights at Freddy's, Scott Cawthon made a cute family game called Chipper & Sons Lumber Co.

Reviewers said its smiling beavers looked like creepy animatronics. Cawthon was crushed and thought about quitting.

Then he flipped the insult into an idea: what if the creepy animatronics were the point? FNAF became one of the biggest indie horror series ever.

Would you have kept going after reviews like that?
